text: ok here is a bug: build something -> create paint atlas -> move around uv -> delete a outliner -> uv will shift around -> undo -> texture image gets corrupted
resolution: Fixed Outliner deletion after authored UV movement by treating a non-empty part delete as an indexed subset install. Surviving UV rows and the resident atlas now remain byte-for-byte unchanged, so delete no longer shifts UV islands and immediate undo restores against the same coordinate revision. Added an exact raster/UV/opacity regression and verified paint, paint-program, mesh-journal, mesh-edit, and ReleaseFast editor checks.
